47. The method of claim 46 including compressing a second porous medium support near an outer edge of the second porous medium support to form a groove on at least one of first and second surfaces of the second porous medium support.
48. The method of claim 46 or 47 including placing the first porous medium support at a first end of the stacked porous media.
49. The method of claim 47 or 48 including placing the second porous medium support at a second end of the stacked porous media.
50. The method of claim 47, 48 or 49 including compressing the stacked porous media between the first and second porous medium supports.
51. The method of any one of claims 46 to 50 including applying at least one coat of a polymer to an outer periphery of each porous medium support.
52. The method of claim 51 including applying at least one coat of the polymer to a side surface of each porous medium support.

53. The method of claim 51 or 52 including applying at least one coat of the polymer to at least one of the first and second surfaces of each porous medium support between the groove and the outer edge of the porous medium support.

54. The method of any one of claims 46 to 47 including applying a tape to at least one of the first and second surfaces of each porous medium support between the groove and the outer edge of the porous medium support before disposing the liquid sealant around the outer periphery of the stacked porous media.
55. The method of claim 54 including peeling off the tape from the porous medium supports after the liquid sealant has solidified.
56. The method of any one of claims 46 to 55 including filling the grooves of the porous medium supports with the polymer.
58. The method of any one of claims 51 to 56, wherein the polymer is bicomponent polyurethane.
59. The method of claim 58, wherein applying at least one coat of bicomponent polyurethane includes applying at least two coats of bicomponent polyurethane.
60. The method of any one of claims 46 to 59 including placing the first porous medium support at a first end of the stacked porous media.

61. The method of claim 60, wherein a first surface of the first porous medium support contacts the first end surface of the stacked porous media and a second surface of the first porous medium support faces away from the stacked porous media.
62. The method of claim 60 or 61 including placing the second porous medium support at a second end of the stacked porous media.

63. The method of claim 61, wherein a first surface of the second porous medium support contacts the second end surface of the stacked porous media and a second surface of the second porous medium support faces away from the stacked porous media.
64. The method of any one of claims 46 to 63 including placing the stacked porous media and each porous medium support in a hollow housing member.
65. The method of claim 64 including centering the stacked porous media and each porous medium support in the hollow housing member using a plurality of spacers.
66. The method of claim 64 or 65 including placing the stacked porous media, each porous medium support and the hollow housing member in a mold.
67. The method of claim 66, wherein the housing member includes two open ends, and the mold closes the two open ends of the housing member.

68. The method of any one of claims 64 to 67, wherein disposing a liquid sealant around the outer periphery of the stack of porous media includes injecting the sealant into the housing member slowly at a low pressure.

69. The method of any one of claims 46 to 68, wherein disposing a liquid sealant around the outer periphery of the stacked porous media includes allowing the sealant to flow over each porous medium support so that the sealant covers an area of the second surface of each porous medium support between the compressed groove and the outer edge of the porous medium support.

70. A porous medium module for use in separations, the porous medium module comprising: a plurality of stacked porous media having an outer periphery and a first end; and a sealant disposed around the outer periphery of the stacked porous media, the sealant forming at least a portion of a first seal gland near the first end of the stack.
71. The porous medium module of claim 70, wherein the stack has a second end, and the sealant forms at least a portion of a second seal gland near the second end of the stack.

A porous medium module for use in separations, the porous medium module comprising: a plurality of stacked porous media having an outer periphery and a first end; and a sealant disposed around the outer periphery of the stacked porous media, the sealant forming a first seat arrangement near the first end of the stack.

an outlet; the porous medium module of any one of the claims 1 to 39, 70 and 71; and a porous medium module holder, wherein the porous medium module is disposed in the porous medium module holder.
75. The chromatography device of claim 74, wherein the holder includes first and second plates between which the porous medium module is disposed.

76. The chromatography device of claim 74 comprising first and second seals, wherein the first seal seals a gap between the first plate and the porous medium module, and the second plate seals a gap between the second plate and the porous medium module.
